other.about: The parts palette (compound ships, CM13): every part in the one part format (packages/ui-contract/src/parts.ts). Real stages, engines, power sources, arrays, dishes and a bay with the figures they flew with and the year they first flew; generic primitives with geometry only. Physics names only (ruling 14A.5). Built by scripts/build-base-parts.py; do not edit by hand.
